task:
A store buys 23 units at 2000 credits each and 46 units at 2003 credits each. It returns 3 units from the FIRST batch at their original unit cost. What is the exact weighted average cost of the remaining units? After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 21 credits, then discount the whole amount by 16%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 15% surcharge, then subtract 27 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 10 credits, then discount the whole amount by 11%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 15% surcharge, then subtract 22 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 15 credits, then discount the whole amount by 7%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 17% surcharge, then subtract 27 credits.

Adjustment 9: add 11 credits, then discount the whole amount by 14%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 6% surcharge, then subtract 25 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 23 credits, then discount the whole amount by 17%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 15% surcharge, then subtract 14 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 19 credits, then discount the whole amount by 7%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 17% surcharge, then subtract 12 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 14 credits, then discount the whole amount by 10%.
Adjustment 16: apply a 7% surcharge, then subtract 19 credits.
Adjustment 17: add 27 credits, then discount the whole amount by 6%.
Adjustment 18: apply a 19% surcharge, then subtract 11 credits.
Adjustment 19: add 17 credits, then discount the whole amount by 14%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
